title: Clarify which owner is accountable for cleanup of landed and unlanded candidates
outcome: Cleanup instructions identify one accountable owner for each candidate lifecycle while keeping Codex as directory/worktree executor.
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md distinguish the integration owner's accountability for a landed candidate from the author's accountability otherwise, without changing Codex's executor restriction or adding deletion authority.

The exact instruction wording follows the existing coordinator-concurrence, Greg-notification and final-diff-audit procedure, with required review/gate evidence; no Markdown phrase-pinning tests are introduced.
